claim: the decisive variable is what becomes of the losing position; synthesis followed where the defeated critique kept an organ, a holder with standing independent of the executive, and a route
quote: The decisive variable in the record is what happens to the losing position after the decision. The amount of conflict matters far less. Synthesis followed where the defeated critique kept three things: an organ in which it could keep being stated, a holder with standing independent of the executive, and a route by which the majority could later adopt it without calling that adoption surrender.
